source.name: Red Bull – BORA – hansgrohe: Flying Look — Red Bull – BORA – hansgrohe takes off with a style update
source.quote: Red Bull – BORA – hansgrohe enters the 2026 season together with Specialized with a new look – while staying true to its own history.
source.note: Title sponsor. Red Bull bulls + 'Red Bull' fill the centre of the chest and the upper back, and are repeated on the shorts thighs; seen in the launch photos (https://img.redbull.com/images/q_auto,f_auto/redbullcom/2025/12/14/ihddp3ryrjwwoe7qwntz/2026-jersey-of-red-bull---bora---hansgrohe) and on Specialized's replica jersey product page (front/back renders: https://www.specialized.com/us/en/red-bull-bora-hansgrohe-short-sleeve-race-jersey/p/1000277927). Red Bull is also the club's majority owner (InrNG sponsors guide, 2026-07-10).

source.name: Red Bull – BORA – hansgrohe: Flying Look — Red Bull – BORA – hansgrohe takes off with a style update
source.quote: Red Bull – BORA – hansgrohe enters the 2026 season together with Specialized with a new look – while staying true to its own history.
source.note: Title sponsor. 'BORA' sits below Red Bull on the chest and the upper back; 'BORA hansgrohe' on the blue shoulders; 'BORA' down the sleeve fronts, down both shorts legs and on the collar tape. Seen in the launch photos cited in the Red Bull entry and in Specialized's replica renders.

source.name: Red Bull – BORA – hansgrohe: Flying Look — Red Bull – BORA – hansgrohe takes off with a style update
source.quote: Red Bull – BORA – hansgrohe enters the 2026 season together with Specialized with a new look – while staying true to its own history.
source.note: Title sponsor. 'hansgrohe' sits below BORA on the chest and upper back, in the under-arm green side panels, on the blue shoulders, on the collar tape and across the back of the shorts. Seen in the launch photos cited above and in Specialized's replica renders. hansgrohe's own site confirms the sponsorship: 'hansgrohe has been a proud sponsor of the Red Bull – BORA – hansgrohe UCI WorldTeam since 2017' (https://www.hansgrohe.com/about-us/sports-sponsorship).

source.name: Red Bull – BORA – hansgrohe: Ready for takeoff — our new collection is now available
source.quote: The collection follows the design approach developed together with Specialized
source.note: Kit manufacturer (per the convention for kit suppliers). Specialized's S-logo sits on the chest above the 'UCI WORLD TEAM' device, on the lower back, on both rear shoulders and on the shorts; 'SPECIALIZED' text under it on the lower back and on the helmet. Renders on Specialized's own 'Race Jersey' product page: https://www.specialized.com/us/en/red-bull-bora-hansgrohe-short-sleeve-race-jersey/p/1000277927.

source.name: Specialized: Red Bull - BORA - hansgrohe Short Sleeve Race Jersey (product page)
source.quote: worn by some of the world’s best riders
source.note: 'AUTO EDER' appears in small type at the very top of the jersey's back, below the collar; visible on the back render of Specialized's official 2026 race-jersey replica (image RBH-RACE-JERSEY-SS-LTD-WHT-RB-BLU_BACK on this page). Auto Eder is also co-title sponsor of the junior team grenke – Auto Eder.

summary: 2026 UCI WorldTeam. Title sponsors Red Bull, BORA and hansgrohe fill the chest and upper back; grenke sits on the upper chest, BOSS down both sleeves, MEWA on the sleeve cuffs, AUTO EDER at the top of the back, and the kit is made by Specialized, whose logo also appears. Every placement checked on the team's launch photos, race photos and Specialized's official replica (front, back, both sides).
